command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'uid='; id -u
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'timezone_status_begin\n'
timedatectl status
printf 'timezone_status_end\n'
printf 'localtime_target='; readlink -f /etc/localtime
printf 'clock='; date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z %Z'
printf 'target_zoneinfo='; test -r /usr/share/zoneinfo/America/Toronto && printf 'present\n'
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true
